reason: A Feishu/Lark integration that provides bidirectional chat between Feishu and DSH agents, including workspace routing and outbound agent messaging; human review is warranted because it handles bot credentials, external network communication, and relaxed TLS verification.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书机器人与 DSH 智能体进行双向聊天，并提供凭据配置、工作区路由和主动发送消息功能。
summaries.en: Connects Feishu bots with DSH agents for two-way chat, credential configuration, workspace routing, and agent-initiated messages.

capabilities: Stores Feishu App ID and App Secret in a local configuration file
Maintains a Feishu WebSocket connection for inbound messages
Routes inbound Feishu messages to agents associated with a selected workspace
Sends agent-generated messages to Feishu chats
Provides settings for credentials and workspace routing
